paragraphs.text: Delete a chat from the DeepSeek Harness sidebar for good — gone immediately, nothing archived.
# chat-trash
> Permanently delete a chat from the DeepSeek Harness sidebar — no archive copy left behind.
Built by **mars-area**.
One entry appears in a Session's `···` menu in the sidebar:
- **Delete chat…** — confirms, then removes the chat: its running turn is stopped, its workspace mem
bership, pin and archive marks are cleared, and its stored log and projection cache are deleted. The
page reloads; the chat is gone from every view, not moved to the archive and not kept in a trash fo
reloads; the chat is gone from every view, not moved to the archive and not kept in a trash folder.
The row is drawn with `MenuItemButton` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, the same primit
ive the shipped Pin, Rename, Fork and Archive rows use, and carries the app's `IconTrashOutlineRegul
ar` trash icon — so its type, weight, padding, icon size and hover treatment match the rest of the m
enu rather than imitating it.
## Install

1. In the Harness Web UI open **Plugins** in the sidebar.
2. **Add plugin → Install a third-party pl

ugin**.

bundle on if it is not on yet.

n if it is not on yet.

To work on the plugin, install your local checkout instead by entering its absolute
path (`C:\Users\

<user>\projects\dsh-chat-trash`); toggle the bundle off and on

## What a delete does

1. Stops any running turn, job, subagent or scheduled reminder of that chat.
2. Takes the live Sessi
on out of the session store, so the sidebar stops listing it at once and persistence drains its last
events and closes the log handle. Without this step a chat deleted only on disk lingered under *Ung

rouped* until the next launch.
3. Clears the chat's pin, its workspace membership and any archive ma

rk, so no row or archived copy survives anywhere.
4. Deletes `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<workspace>/<sessi

on-id>/` and its `<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_projcache` row.
5. Reloads the page, so the conversati
on pane cannot keep showing a chat whose log no longer exists.
An open but idle chat is deletable. DSH keeps every chat you have opened live in memory for the run,
so "is this chat open?" is not a usable test — the plugin does not make it.
## There is no undo

The log is deleted, not archived, so keep a copy first when it matters: use the
Session header's **D

ownload session log** action or the `/export` command, which
writes a ZIP of the session, its sub-se
ssions and attachments.
## Limits
- DSH has no delete API by design, so this bundle edits the persistence directory behind the seam. A
future Harness version may change the log layout or the `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` cont
ract; the plugin then fails loudly (the button reports the error) or stops appearing, and should be

updated.
- Deleting only affects this machine. Logs already uploaded by *Settings → General → Upload

Session Log when using the official model API* cannot be reached from here.
- Turning the bundle of
f in Plugins removes the menu row; chats already deleted stay deleted.

Made by **mars-area**. Issues and patches belong there.
